name: postlite
description: Lightweight, Docker-free, self-hosted social media scheduler for YouTube, Instagram and Facebook Pages.

scripts.cf:deploy: wrangler deploy && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote

TOKEN_ENC_KEY.description: 32 random bytes, base64 (`openssl rand -base64 32`). Encrypts platform tokens at rest. Never change it after connecting accounts.

SESSION_SECRET.description: Random string used to pepper session ids (`openssl rand -base64 32`).

CF_ACCESS_TEAM_DOMAIN.description: Your Zero Trust team domain, e.g. `myteam.cloudflareaccess.com`.

CF_ACCESS_AUD.description: Application Audience (AUD) tag of the Access application.

ALLOWED_EMAILS.description: Comma-separated emails allowed to sign in (enforced by postlite too).

PUBLIC_URL.description: Public URL of this Worker, e.g. `https://postlite.example.com`.
